executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Use the configured frontend login credentials from testsprite_tests/tmp/config.json for authenticated flows. The local stack runs over HTTP, not HTTPS. The backend, engine, and frontend are already running in Docker on localhost. If a test requires authentication, log in through the UI rather than injecting a bearer token. After login, the app lands on /overview and the current shell uses a Workflows label for graph access; do not require a visible 'Graphs' navigation link. For protected graph-listing coverage, use the visible Workflows navigation item when present, or navigate directly to /workflows or /graphs. The backend fixture command seed_testsprite_frontend_fixture has already populated test@example.com with a newest editable prompt, one pending approval, one visible memory observation, and one visible credential card for deterministic browser coverage.
